rendered:
Knocking out dacA, which encodes a peptidoglycan synthase acting as a negative regulator ("[1]), was identified by transposon mutagenesis (Pan et al.). In the dacA-deleted strain, the knockout "[2]" altered cell morphology and increased membrane permeability, which facilitated intracellular prodigiosin release and upregulated pigA. The result was a yield increase of "[3][4]2.46-fold[5] over wild-type JNB5–1 ("[6]lating pigA, resulting in a 2.46-fold yield increase over wild-type JNB5–1[7]).

The dacA deletion is carried by strain SK4–72[8], which the table lists as JNB5–1 → SK4–72[9] (the table row describes the dacA deletion to enhance prodigiosin in that strain).
